description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeeMembershipController class within the OrangeHRM system. It manages the employee membership view, retrieving services, preparing Vue component properties, and setting permissions for employee membership management functions.

classes.name: EmployeeMembershipController
classes.description: Controller managing employee membership data and view rendering within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getMembershipService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns an instance of MembershipService.

methods.name: getPayGradeService
methods.description: Retrieves the PayGradeService instance from the dependency container.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component with employee membership data and sets permissions before rendering.

methods.name: getDataGroupsForCapabilityCheck
methods.description: Returns data groups relevant for capability permissions, specifically 'membership'.
